Hello, my name is Nathanaël Soulage, I am a PhD student at Sciences Po Paris. I mainly work on Public Economics, with complementary interest in Labor and Macroeconomics.

I have previously worked as a predoc for Prof. Stefanie Stantcheva (Harvard University). I hold a Bachelor's degree in Political and Social Sciences from Sciences Po, with a major in Economics. I then completed a Research Master's degree in Economics, at Sciences Po, graduating in June 2025. For more details you can find my resume [here](Nathanael_Soulage_resume.pdf). 

Many thanks to the amazing Paulo Gugelmo Cavalheiro Dias, who designed a wonderful tutorial to create your own [Research Portfolio](https://www.paulogcd.com/portfolio_tutorial/)
